suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-8 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Anemia is a recognized clinical hallmark of primary myelofibrosis in the setting of marrow fibrosis and disordered hematopoiesis. Require established primary myelofibrosis and separately documented anemia. Preserve bleeding, nutritional deficiency, renal disease, hemolysis, treatment effects, coexisting marrow disease, and leukemic transformation as competing or contributing explanations. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
